content: Kirstoosa Baggara Beettida Issifeteth
Hessa gishshas Godaa sunththan qashettida tani intte xeygettida xeyssaas bessiza duus daana mala inttena woossays.
Mulekka ashketanne shugota gidite; issoy issaara siiqon diitenne issoy issaa dandayte.
Saroteth immiza Ayana issifeteth naaganaas minnite.
Intte xeygettida gallas issi hidotaakko xeygettida mala issi asateththinne issi Ayanay dees.
Issi Goday, issi ammanoynne issi xinqatay dees.
Ubbaafe bollara gididay, ubbaa bolla ooththizay, ubbason dizay, ubbaas Aawaa gidida issi Xoossi dees.
Gidikkoka Kirstoosi immana gi qachchida mala nuus issaas issaas dumma dumma imoteththi imettides.
Hessa gishshas,
geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Histtiin, «Izi pude kezides» guussi qasseka duge biitta gars wodhdhides guus gidontta aggiko hessi ay guussee?
Izi duge garse wodhdhidayssi kumeth alame medheteth kumana mala saloppeka bolla keziday iza.
Issi issi asati Hawaareta, baggayti Nabeta, harati Mishiraachcho qaala sabaake, baggayti qasse heemmizaytanne tamaarsizayta gidana mala izi imota immides.
Hessika Kirstoosa asateth gidida Woosa Keeththiya keexettana mala ammanizayta ammano oosos giigsanaassa.
Hessika hananay nu wurikka Xoossa Naa ammanoninne iza eron beettiza issifeteththaako gakkidi kumeththa as gidanaas Kirstoosan nuni Kirstoosaththo kumeththinne polo gidana malassa.
Hessa gishshas abba bolla dendiza gote carkoy yaanne haa shocechchiza mala dumma dumma timirte carkon asa geneninne baleththon ane nuni yaanne haa phonqettishe qeeri guuththa nayta mala hanokko.
Hessaththo hano aggidi tumaa siiqon haasayshe hu7e gididayssaako hanizaazan ubbaan ane diccoos; he hu7ezikka Kirstoosa.
Iza gaason asateththi wuri xaphon oykettidi issi issi asateththi ba ooso ooththishe wurikka siiqon dicceessinne banakka minththees.
Poo7o Nayta Mala Duus
Ayzaabeta mala coo mela qofan mela simerettanaas inttes bessenna gaada ta inttena zorays.
Istta wozinay muumida gishshassinne yuushshi qoppontta gishshas istta wozina ayfey qooqides; istti Xoossa de7oppe shaakettida.
Isttafe yeellateththi dhayda gishshas ba koyida mala bana kalssontta amoninne tunateththan daanaas wogay baynda iita oosos bana aaththi immida.
Intte qasse Kirstoosa hessa malan eribeekketa.
Ee tumukka intte iza gishshas siyidetanne Yesusan diza tumaa izappe tamaardeta.
Intte kase diza duussay baleththiza amon qitattida gishshas kase ceega asateth inttefe qaari yeggana mala tamaardeta.
Qasseka intte qofay Ayanan ooraxo.
Tumu xilloteththaninne geeshshateththan Xoos misatana medhettida ooraththa asateth may7ite.
Nu wurikka issi asho gidida gishshas wordoteth diggidi nuni nu garsan issoy issaara ane tumaa haasayoos.
Hanqettite shin nagara ooththofte; intte hanqon dishin arshey wullofo.
Xala7es soho immofte.
Kase kaysotizaadey hayssafe guye kaysotoppa; gido attiin metotettidi iza woossizaytas immiza miishshi iza kushen daana mala lo7o miish ba kushera ooththi demmanaas daaburo.
Koshshiza mala hankko siyizayta go7izaazinne maaddiza qaalappe attiin go7ay baynda qaalay intte doonappe kezoppo.
Intte attana gallassas attamettida Xoossaa Xillo Ayana mishisopite.
Camo yo7o ubbaa hanqo, yiillo, oosh, cashshe, qasseka hankko hara iitateth ubbaa inttefe diggite.
Inttena Xoossi Kirstoosa baggara atto gida mala intteka intte garsan atto atto geetettite; issoy issaara kiyatanne issoy issaas qadhettizayta gidite.
